description: youtube: Search Typeahead. GET /v1/youtube/search/typeahead. Get the live autocomplete suggestions shown in YouTube's search dropdown. Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.
